text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Nigeria's proposed National Health Insurance Scheme is being put on hold due to a lack of funds and of relevant legislation.
- Desperate for money, large numbers of Nigerian girls have taken to prostitution abroad.
- Water prices may increase if plans by the government to commercialise water distribution are put into effect.
- Following signals that military ruler General Sani Abacha may not stand in 1998 presidential elections, political parties have started looking for possible alternative contendors.
